name: Fractal Brownian Motion
aliases: 3D Perlin Noise with Fractal Brownian Motion (FBM)
3D Perlin-like Noise and Fractal Brownian Motion (FBM)
definition: A texture generation technique that generates spatially and temporally varying values by combining multiple octaves of Perlin noise.
summary: Fractal Brownian Motion generates self-similar, multi-scale stochastic patterns by summing multiple octaves of a base noise function with increasing frequency and decreasing amplitude.
